failure_reason: Home-department Clearance parent listing fully verified (811 products, direct HTTP fetch), and the site's own pill-navigation on that page proved 11 genuine child Clearance listings exist (Appliances, Bathroom, Bedroom, Furniture + Outdoor, Home Decor, Kitchen, Lighting, Pet, Storage + Laundry, Tableware, Travel). All 11 child URLs were then blocked by Akamai bot-management ('Access Denied' title, ~325-335 byte body) - reproduced via curl_cffi (403, two browser impersonation profiles) and again via headless Playwright/Chromium with a fresh context, realistic UA, and 6s pacing between navigations (all 11 still returned the Access Denied interstitial). Per the access-tier rules this was treated as a genuine block on those specific sub-paths (not chased further into Claude-in-Chrome) - their names/links are recorded with qty:null and a flag rather than omitted, since their existence is independently confirmed by the parent page's own navigation.
notes: Home-department scope only. Checked: main mega menu (no direct Clearance item; top-level nav uses 'Sale' -> /deals, a generic promo page, not this taxonomy), footer SEO link dump which explicitly labels '/c/clearance/home/W676715' with title/link text 'Clearance' for the Home department (same pattern repeated per department: Women/Men/Kids/Baby/Toys/Entertainment/Beauty all have their own '/c/clearance/<dept>/<id>' link) - this is the site's own clearance taxonomy, distinct from the generic '/deals' Sale page, so the Sale-vs-Clearance test in the brief is satisfied (dedicated URL namespace '/c/clearance/...', its own group_id, its own <title> 'Clearance Home'). Opened /c/clearance/home/W676715 directly: title 'Clearance Home', data-cnstrc-num-results=811, and a pill-navigation carousel exposing 11 real Home sub-department clearance children plus an 'All Clearance' link to the sitewide clearance root (/c/clearance/W676714, out of scope - not Home-specific, excluded). Recorded parent + all 11 children per the genuine-substructure rule; children's exact counts blocked (see failure_reason). Did not find any other clearance/outlet/final-sale/end-of-line page for Home beyond this branch.
